Solution title: Community-scale water treatment / safe-water & hygiene intervention
Where implemented: Rural & school settings in India (incl. Jharkhand-relevant contexts)
Implementer: Govt/NGO/university partnerships (e.g., UNICEF, HUL, community orgs)
Outcome (short, verified): Improved drinking-water quality in schools/communities; mixed long-term household adoption without sustained support

Solution title: Micro drip irrigation (MDI) for vegetable cultivation
Where implemented: Kanke & Ratu blocks, Ranchi district, Jharkhand
Implementer: Birsa Agricultural University; JSLPS (JHIMDI / I-HIMDI project, JICA-funded)
Outcome (short, verified): Study of 200 farmers: cucumber & tomato most profitable under MDI; high post-harvest losses in tomato (~59%); water savings & higher productivity vs conventional irrigation reported in related BAU trials

Solution title: Solar-powered cold storage with dehumidifier for FPOs/cooperatives
Where implemented: Verified case: Dehradun district, Uttarakhand (not Jharkhand); separate Jharkhand solar cold storage sites exist in Gumla & Koderma (JREDA) but with no published income figures found
Outcome (short, verified): ~15% pulses wastage reduced via solar cold storage w/ dehumidifier in the verified (non-Jharkhand) case; Jharkhand sites unverified for income impact
>170,000 teleconsultations in first ~6 months; later >300,000 over ~2.5 years; 63% patients with NCDs; 53% female beneficiaries

Solution title: Small rainwater harvesting ponds (doba) with supplemental irrigation
Outcome (short, verified): Documented increase in paddy yields from ~900 kg/acre to ~1,700 kg/acre in program villages; improved winter vegetable cultivation

Solution title: School-based safe water & hygiene intervention (purifiers + education)
Where implemented: Southern India pilot (concept transferable to Jharkhand schools)
Outcome (short, verified): Increased awareness & some increase in purifier ownership; sustained household behavior change limited without ongoing engagement

Problem title: High diarrhoeal disease due to unsafe water
Where implemented: Kali River, Dandeli, Karnataka (pilot; model transferable)
Outcome (short, verified): Bacterial removal up to >99%; self-reported health improved; no statistically significant diarrhea reduction in stepped-wedge trial (low uptake, low baseline)

Problem title: Lack of specialist access; high travel burden
Implementer: Govt of Jharkhand + national eSanjeevani platform; evaluated by Intelehealth
Outcome (short, verified): 175,490 teleconsultations in evaluation period; ~21.6 km & ~₹941 saved/visit; 96.5% treatment compliance; 60% full + 25% partial recovery

Solution title: Solar dryers & cold storage for horticulture FPOs (JH-RESET)
Where implemented: Coal-mining districts (e.g., Chatra, Koderma, Dhanbad belt)
Implementer: State Horticulture Dept, JREDA, FPOs; funds from DMFT, SCF, ADP
Outcome (short, verified): 20% reduction in food waste; ~30% increase in farmer wages in pilot; monthly income ↑ ₹3,000–4,000 per dryer; overall annual income increase for ~200 tomato farmers

Solution title: Community-managed low-cost water filter (iron removal, potable water)
Where implemented: Urban/peri-urban low-income settlement (India; concept transferable to Jharkhand towns)
Implementer: Community organization + technical support; managed by local youth/children groups
Outcome (short, verified): Improved access to potable water at community scale; reduced iron & better taste/acceptance
